# Domain Intelligence Engine

> Domain intelligence for humans and agents: generate candidates, verify availability, score meaning, compare registrar prices.

## What it does

Full domain intelligence pipeline:
- **Verify** domain availability via DNS + RDAP (authoritative)
- **Generate** domain candidates from a concept
- **Score** domains by semantic meaning, length, hyphens, TLD
- **Compare** registrar prices (Cloudflare, Porkbun, Dynadot, Namecheap)
- **Mine** — full pipeline: generate + verify + score + compare
- **Bulk verify** — check up to 50 domains at once

## MCP Tools

- `verify_domain` — Full verification pipeline: DNS probe + RDAP registration check
- `generate_domains` — Generate domain candidates from a concept + TLDs
- `score_domain` — Score a domain by semantic meaning, length, TLD
- `compare_registrars` — Compare domain prices across registrars
- `mine_domains` — Full pipeline: generate + verify + score + compare (top 20 candidates)
- `get_analytics` — Get search and click analytics

## MCP Endpoint

```bash
curl -X POST https://domainnamechecker.dev/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

## API

```bash
# Verify a domain (DNS + RDAP)
curl https://domainnamechecker.dev/api/verify/example.com

# Compare registrar prices
curl https://domainnamechecker.dev/api/registrar/example.com

# Bulk verify up to 50 domains
curl -X POST https://domainnamechecker.dev/api/bulk-verify \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"domains":["example.com","test.com","demo.com"]}'

# Mine domains (full pipeline)
curl -X POST https://domainnamechecker.dev/api/mine \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"concept":"tiny api tools","intent":"get","tlds":["com"]}'

# Health check
curl https://domainnamechecker.dev/api/health
```

## Verification output

```json
{
  "domain": "example.com",
  "registration": {
    "status": "taken",
    "confidence": 0.99,
    "authoritative": true,
    "verified_at": "2026-08-21T12:00:00Z"
  },
  "evidence": [
    { "source": "dns", "status": "records_found" },
    { "source": "rdap", "status": "registered" }
  ],
  "schema_version": "3.0.0"
}
```
